headlines.title: CDC steps in as Pennsylvania battles deadly measles outbreak
headlines.description: The CDC is sending one of its scientists to Pennsylvania to help curb the state’s growing measles outbreak, the agency said Thursday.

headlines.title: MAHA fractures deepen as some RFK Jr. followers turn into harsh critics
headlines.description: A scorecard from MAHA activists suggests the Trump administration has broken most of its promises to the movement. The “burn feels especially raw,” one prominent activist said.

headlines.title: The secret to a good night’s rest? Let sleeping dogs lie — next to you
headlines.description: A surprising new study found that people who sleep near their dogs don’t experience disrupted sleep. If anything we humans are the ones disturbing our dogs’ sleep.

headlines.title: First New Sunscreen Type in 25 Years Hits US Store Shelves
headlines.description: For the first time in more than 25 years, Americans have a new option when shopping for sunscreen. The FDA-approved bemotrizinol is a skin-protecting chemical available in Europe and other parts of the world and is now hitting US shelves.

headlines.title: Why Survivor-to-Survivor Breast Cancer Support Matters
headlines.description: TODAY contributor Jill Martin was declared cancer free in 2025 after two years of treatment. Less than a year later, she connected with Val Talve, a mother of two young boys recently diagnosed with breast cancer, and they quickly became close friends. Now, both cancer-free, Jill and Val join Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to discuss how their relationship helped them heal, the importance of sisterhood in times of adversity, and the organization Val founded to uplift women around the world.

headlines.title: Try These Healthier Takes on Popular Halloween Candies
headlines.description: Start TODAY’s Joy Bauer shares a healthier take on some popular Halloween candies. See her recipes for chocolate peanut butter snap bars, peanut butter and jelly crispy treats and chocolate caramel candies!

headlines.title: Pope Leo Shares First Message After Lung Cancer Surgery
headlines.description: Pope Leo XIV is on the mend two days after surgery for adenocarcinoma, the most common form of lung cancer. The 71-year-old pontiff shared a first message saying he is “grateful for the outpouring of support” and asking them to “keep praying” as he recovers. NBC’s Anne Thompson reports for TODAY from Rome.

headlines.title: Experts say this is the best time to clean your gutters
headlines.description: Clean your gutters too early and you’ll have to do it again, wait too long and they could overflow. Experts explain when to clean them and how to do it.

headlines.title: Home Depot’s holiday sweater is back — grab it before it sells out again
headlines.description: Home Depot’s limited-edition holiday sweater sold out in minutes. It restocks today with over $200 in tools for $29.99. Here’s how to buy it.

headlines.title: This $190 small space heater is marked down to just $25 today
headlines.description: The Amumu Portable Space Heater is on sale for $25 at Walmart. It’s quiet, small enough to fit on or under a desk, and has tip-over and overheat protection.

headlines.title: How to polish your wood furniture and make it look (almost) brand new
headlines.description: I learned the best products for cleaning and polishing wood furniture, including wood tables, cabinets, chairs and more.

headlines.title: 9 Simple Lifestyle Habits That Are Better for Improving Bone Density Than Taking Supplements
headlines.description: If you’re looking to improve your bone density and prevent fractures, try these science-backed lifestyle habits instead of relying on bone health supplements alone.
